name: Base Access
description: Perfect for self-motivated lifters who want high-quality equipment without the extra fuss.
features: Unlimited access to the main gym floor (free weights & strength machines)
Full use of the cardio deck
Locker room and private shower access
1 complimentary guest pass per month
Access during standard hours (5:00 AM – 11:00 PM)
Standard booking window (3 days in advance)

name: Peak Performance
description: Our most popular plan. Ideal if you love energy, community, and crushing group fitness goals.
features: Includes EVERYTHING in Base Access
24/7 keycard access to the facility
Unlimited Group Fitness Classes (HIIT, Yoga, Spin, Strength)
4 complimentary guest passes per month
Access to the Recovery Zone (Sauna & Steam room)
10% discount at the smoothie bar and merchandise shop
Priority booking window (7 days in advance)

name: Elite Results
description: The ultimate accountability package. Direct coaching and testing to guarantee you hit your targets.
features: Includes EVERYTHING in Base & Peak tiers
4 Small-Group Personal Training sessions per month (Max 4 people per coach)
Monthly 1-on-1 progress review & customized workout adjustment
Monthly InBody biometric body composition scanning
Customized nutritional macro targets updated monthly
Complimentary gym towel service every visit
VIP booking window (14 days in advance for classes & trainers)
